criteria: The registry ID and root URL are not already registered or reserved by a prior registry entry.
The exact two-field entry passes the pinned registry entry validator, including metadata mirror, Rashid 0.3.0 and stac-node-validator 2.0.0.
Run the unmodified pinned catalog-grader collector in a disposable GitHub runner with the source repository and --registry-submission; retain its facts and collected documents/images.
Review every collected root and collection README and AGENTS document, all five thumbnails, and the published source citations for data claims.
Apply the complete upstream rubric without a minimum grade added after seeing results; the grade is advisory, deterministic errors block submission.
Record unavailable sources, environment errors, unsupported and contradicted claims separately; do not turn incomplete checks into passing results.
Preserve failed runs and pin all final evidence to the reviewed Git commit and upstream revisions.
Before requesting upstream review, obtain the human review of the exact entry and PR text required by the registry contribution policy.
exclusions: No asset rebuilds, source uploads, GEE exports or new whole-dataset downloads.
No registry merge or main-branch history rewrite.

fix_criteria.scope: Correct catalog hosting, generated consumer documentation, field descriptions and display styles without rebuilding analytical data or PMTiles.
criteria: Preserve the baseline D report and original collector measurements.
Make no changes to the six analytical Parquet and six PMTiles objects or their declared hashes.
Use verified Source URLs for display assets; published metadata remains on GitHub Pages.
Regenerate collection READMEs with executable examples from the existing Source publication metadata and dataset-specific AGENTS guidance.
Attach descriptions from the retained producer field dictionaries without inventing coded values or scientific claims.
Use existing PMTiles properties for thematic styles; inspect each resulting thumbnail and validate named fields against tile metadata.
Pass focused generator and hosting-pin refusal tests and a clean-checkout regeneration.
After authorized metadata publication, rerun the unmodified upstream collector and registry gate and preserve the new facts separately.
Require zero live-hosting errors and runnable documented examples; assess remaining advisory findings with the unchanged upstream rubric.
Do not add scheduled jobs, new products, dataset downloads, or history rewrites.
